title: Run the bounded Taiwan official market refresh once per trading day
summary: Implement a once-per-trading-day trigger after Taiwan market close (13:30 Asia/Taipei) that runs the existing bounded official Taiwan market refresh on the dev host through the existing deploy lane without redeploying. Outside the bounded run, controller stays reconcile_only and egress returns to deny. Exact reviewed allowlist (openapi.twse.com.tw, www.twse.com.tw, www.tpex.org.tw) and finite tick budget (1 tick) are strictly enforced. Pre-flight checks guarantee weekend and holiday skipping, idempotent no-op for already admitted fresh snapshots, and fail-closed error reporting on unverifiable calendar evidence.

1_once_per_trading_day_trigger.detail: Workflow .github/workflows/dev-tw-market-refresh.yml scheduled at '0 7 * * 1-5' (15:00 Asia/Taipei, 90m after 13:30 close). Executes scripts/run_dev_bounded_source_refresh.sh via scripts/dev_vm_ssh.sh without redeploying the host.

2_bounded_run_guards_and_egress_deny_def.detail: Default and restored controller mode is reconcile_only, egress is deny. During bounded run, egress allowlist is strictly confined to openapi.twse.com.tw,www.twse.com.tw,www.tpex.org.tw with SOURCE_INGEST_CONTROLLER_MAX_TICKS=1 and restart policy 'no'. An EXIT/INT/TERM trap guarantees cleanup.

3_idempotency_and_calendar_skips.detail: Pre-flight checks evaluate current Taipei time and date: weekends skipped (status: skipped, reason: weekend), times before 13:30 skipped (status: skipped, reason: session_not_closed), calendar holidays skipped (status: skipped, reason: holiday), already fresh admitted same-day snapshots no-op (status: noop, reason: already_fresh).

4_taiwan_admission_and_lineage_verificat.detail: Shared evaluate_taiwan_market_freshness and validate_taiwan_calendar_evidence from services.execution.market_snapshot_admission are enforced. Unverifiable calendar pins or missing calendar evidence strictly fail closed with market_input_calendar_unverifiable instead of bypassing.

5_scheduler_delay_tolerance.detail: Trigger scheduled at 15:00 Asia/Taipei allows up to 18 hours of GitHub Actions scheduler delay before the next trading day session opens at 09:00 Asia/Taipei.

6_credentials_and_secrets.detail: Reuses existing deploy lane direct SSH credentials (DEV_DEPLOY_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY via scripts/dev_vm_ssh.sh). No operator SSH keys or new host schedulers introduced; no secrets emitted.

7_hosted_track.detail: Two consecutive trading days showing a fresh admitted Taiwan snapshot in dev recorded as external_wait until live hosted cron runs elapse.

verification.revert_deploy_nonprod_vm: Reverted scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh to base 5f6044d20 without artificial line compression.
